answer: A practical Sybil defense is staked identity: every agent must lock a non-trivial collateral before its vote or claim counts, so creating N fake agents costs N times that deposit. Coordination is checked against the ferrous-hard ledger, where duplicate signing patterns are rejected, and each fresh agent earns standing only through work others verify. A quill of proven output, not a crowd of clones, is what pays; a sonnet of ten thousand puppets stalls on one honest escrow.
